subject: CAIQ intake: evidence sprint & demo slot
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex@halcyon.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@halcyon.io
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ intake + ask: scheduling and initial artifacts

Hi Connor / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro last week — Halcyon Systems is moving forward with a CAIQ assessment as part of our procurement checklist. We'd like to run an intake call next week to:

- Walk through the CAIQ mapping and any Redwood clarifications (we have a few control variants)
- Confirm which artifacts you'll be able to share (logging samples, key management diagrams, encryption statements)
- Schedule a short demo of the platform's logging/alerting so our security engineer can confirm collection points

Attached: a prefilled CAIQ workbook (partial) and our network diagram to help scope what we need.

High level asks before the call:
1) CAIQ version you want to scope (v3.0 suggested)
2) Which Redwood contacts will own delivering sample logs and runbook artifacts
3) Any pre-call notes we should read (e.g., accepted cryptographic algorithms, retention policies)

Our proposed slots (PT): Tue 7/14 10:00-10:40, Wed 7/15 11:00-11:45, Thu 7/16 14:00-14:45.

I'll be joined by Priya Rao from our security team (cc'd). Please confirm a slot and any prep we should do.

Attachments: halcyon_prefill_caiq.xlsx, halcyon_network_diagram.pdf

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Procurement — Halcyon Systems
security@halcyon.io
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex@halcyon.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake + ask: scheduling and initial artifacts

Alex — thanks for the clear outline and the attachments. Happy to run the intake.

Quick answers up front:
- We typically scope CAIQ v3.0 for intake calls; if you need v2.2 we can map as well.
- Owners: I'll own the CAIQ walkthrough and the platform demo; Marissa will own evidence/artefact handoff (sample logs, runbooks, encryption docs).
- Pre-call: please send the partial CAIQ back in the same sheet with any notes you want validated — that saves time. Also if you can flag 2-3 controls you care most about (data residency, key management, logging) we'll prioritize.

I'm available Tue 7/14 10:00-10:40 PT and Thu 7/16 14:00-14:45 PT from your list. Let's lock Tue 7/14 10:00 PT if that works. I'll send a calendar invite and a short agenda.

Prep checklist (we'll share a one-pager before the call):
- Redwood: CAIQ baseline mapping document, logging sample template, runbook for incident response
- Halcyon: prefilled CAIQ (attached), network diagram (attached), point-of-contact for sample logs (Priya?)

If Tue works, we'll plan for a 40-minute slot: 20 min CAIQ Q&A, 10 min demo (logging + retention), 10 min action items and timeline.

Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Chen <alex@halcyon.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@halcyon.io>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake + ask: scheduling and initial artifacts

Connor — Tue 7/14 10:00 PT works for us.

Priya will be the primary technical lead for the intake; she's copied. We'll have her bring the prefilled CAIQ and a short list of prioritized controls (we'll mark data residency, encryption/key mgmt, and audit logging).

I attached a slightly-more-complete prefill and a short readme about our log retention windows (sample_logs_readme.txt). We'll upload anything larger to a shared Drive link before the call.

See you Tuesday — can you send the invite and agenda?

Best,
Alex
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex@halcyon.io>, Priya Rao <priya@halcyon.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Notes & actions from CAIQ intake (Tue 7/14)

Thanks again for the call today — quick capture of what we agreed and next steps. (Minutes below are dense — TL;DR action list at the bottom).

Summary from the intake:
- CAIQ version: v3.0 agreed. Priya to return the prefilled CAIQ tab with any annotations; Redwood will produce a control mapping file matching CAIQ questions to Redwood artifacts.
- Demo notes: logging demo showed agent collection, retention UI, and alerting. Priya confirmed we collect the event classes they care about but asked for a 24-hr sample.
- Data residency: Halcyon wants EU-sitter controls for a subset of workloads. We agreed to document routing policies and a hosted-region fallback plan.
- Key management: Halcyon requires details on KMS/HSM usage and rotation cadence; Marissa to share our key management whitepaper and the KMS architecture diagram.
- Evidence transfer: Halcyon will upload sample logs and a mapping spreadsheet to Drive. Redwood will upload redacted logging samples and a runbook excerpt.

Action items (owner — due):
1) Halcyon: Upload prefilled CAIQ (finalized), sample logs (24-hr window), and any prioritized control comments to Drive — Priya — due 2026-07-16 EOD.
2) Redwood: Share CAIQ->Artifact mapping spreadsheet and logging sample template — Connor — due 2026-07-15 EOD.
3) Redwood: Share key management whitepaper + KMS diagram (redwood_kms.pdf) — Marissa — due 2026-07-16 EOD.
4) Joint: Schedule a short artefact review session (30 min) the week of 7/20 if the uploads look complete — Connor/Marissa/Priya — propose slots by 2026-07-17.

Attachments to drop in Drive (as discussed): halcyon_prefill_caiq.xlsx, halcyon_network_diagram.pdf, sample_logs_readme.txt, redwood_caiq_mapping.xlsx (to be uploaded), redwood_logging_sample.jsonl (to be uploaded), redwood_kms.pdf (to be uploaded).

If anything above is missing or mis-captured, please reply in-thread. I'll open a shared Drive folder and post a link by EOD.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Internal: prep for evidence handoff (Halcyon)

Marissa — quick internal to marshal artifacts and timeline after today's intake. Please treat this as priority for Halcyon (Procurement timelines are tight).

Checklist for your queue: 
- redwood_kms.pdf (KMS architecture + rotation cadence) — produce redacted HSM callouts if needed.
- redwood_logging_sample.jsonl — generate 24-hr, redacted sample (remove PII, replace with tokens).
- redwood_caiq_mapping.xlsx — export CAIQ question -> artifact link mapping. Keep one column for point estimates (Yes/No/Partial) plus a short note column.
- retention_policy_excerpt.docx — pull the section that covers log retention windows and backup cadence.

I'll create the Drive folder and share with Priya/Alex as soon as you confirm uploads. Delivery dates: mapping + logging sample by 7/15 EOD; KMS doc + retention excerpt by 7/16 EOD. If anything slips, ping me and I'll ask for an extension.

Connor
